title: 监管收紧：不是打压，是在洗掉噪音？
speaker: Kate Zhang

segments.en: July, there was a bit of a drawdown, right? There was all this CSRC had a lot of meetings talking about the usage of AI and quant trading and the like, how has MS Capital fared in that?
segments.zh: 7月有一些回撤，对吧？当时证监会开了很多会议，讨论AI和量化交易的使用等，MS Capital在这方面表现如何？

segments.en: How are you working with these dynamics right now? Yes.
segments.zh: 你们现在如何应对这些动态？是的。

segments.en: I think the regulatory, the tightening of the policy is actually doing less favor.
segments.zh: 我认为监管收紧政策实际上是在做有利的事。

segments.en: They are trying to wash out the bad behaviors and remove the noise from the market.
segments.zh: 他们试图清洗不良行为，去除市场中的噪音。

segments.en: So leave us a clean and healthy playground.
segments.zh: 从而给我们留下一个干净健康的环境。

segments.en: Kate, you talk about some of the noise in the markets.
segments.zh: Kate，你谈到市场中的一些噪音。
